purpose: Provide an explicit additive front door that keeps disabled translation mounts, exact distance joints and distance limits in validated evidence while excluding them from solver residuals and collision-isolation topology before delegating to the established one-step composer path.

properties.constraints: translation mounts, exact distance joints and/or distance limits, each optionally enabled=false
properties.options: optional isolateCollisions boolean plus nested composer or isolation delegate options

contains: final world from exactly one established composer/donor-core step
validated normalized constraints including disabled definitions
active and disabled ids/counts by family

relationships.basis: Disabled definitions are removed before delegation so they cannot contribute stale residuals to convergence diagnostics.
Disabled edges are removed before topology discovery so they cannot suppress collisions inside components they should not connect.
The imported donor core remains byte-for-byte untouched.

limitations: this is an additive safe front door; direct lower-level composer/isolation calls retain their existing compatibility behavior
disabled definitions are still normalized and therefore must reference valid bodies
collision isolation remains component-wide across enabled edges when requested
no angular inertia, rotating anchors, hinge, slider, rotational weld, motor or gear semantics
persistent_state: none; activity partition is derived deterministically for each step

proves: disabled constraints do not enter convergence residuals
disabled edges do not create collision-isolation components
disabled constraints do not suppress ordinary donor-core contacts
enabled constraints continue through component isolation
disabled definitions still undergo source-integrity/body-reference validation

truth.basis: The gate distinguishes retained disabled definitions from the active subset actually solved and used for isolation topology.

agency.basis: Caller enabled=false choices are honored as inert rather than silently affecting convergence or collision suppression.

continuity.basis: The existing composer, isolation layer and donor source remain intact; this is an additive guarded route.

wisdom-before-speed.basis: The correction is bounded to an explicit activity partition instead of rewriting mature lower-level modules mid-lane.
